protocol.dataset_revision_policy: resolve once to an immutable commit before collecting any samples
protocol.selection: smallest width whose best validation reconstruction NRMSE passes; otherwise largest width is diagnostic only
protocol.heldout_policy: no test access until function indices, width, ridge factor, and recovery coefficients are saved and hashed
protocol.claim_scope: single-function approximate optimization; compiler exact mode unchanged; pruning is also implementable in conventional frameworks

performance.latency_scope: compiled C ABI, same inputs/outputs, warmed execution; compilation/loading/tokenization/Python marshalling excluded

caveats: Exploratory single-function, single-model experiment on one runner.
Held out from optimization; source pretraining overlap with WikiText is unknown.
Quality gates use point estimates; article-cluster confidence intervals are also reported.
Pruning and readout reconstruction are available in conventional frameworks too.
Approximate rewrite does not change the exact compiler mode or establish logical proof validity.
